name: kilakochen-assets
description: Build pipeline for minimal Bootstrap assets

scripts.purge:css: purgecss --css kilakochen/static/vendor/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css --content 'kilakochen/templates/**/*.html' --output kilakochen/static/vendor/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css --safelist alert-success alert-info alert-warning alert-danger alert-primary alert-secondary alert-dismissible fade show
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run purge:css && npm run build:js
